name: shadPS4 default guest mapping placement at DEFAULT_MAPPING_BASE = 0x200000000 (SIZE NOT DETERMINABLE FROM SOURCE: DEFAULT_MAPPING_BASE is a search start, not a sized mapping; a modest 16 KiB probe size equal to shadPS4's own default alignment is used here and is an authoring choice, not a source fact)
required_postconditions: the returned address is >= SystemManagedVirtualBase() and < UserVirtualBase() + UserVirtualSize()
the returned address is aligned up to the requested alignment (default 16 KiB)
guest code receives whatever address SearchFree() chose and uses it as-is

NOTE ON guest_host_identity_required=false: shadPS4 has no translation layer anywhere, so guest pointers are always host pointers. But on THIS path the guest supplied address 0 (memory.cpp:563), so there is no caller-chosen address for the host address to be identical to - shadPS4 picks the address itself and reports it back through out_addr. Identity holds trivially rather than being a requirement the host can violate. Setting this flag true would also contradict permitted_fallbacks=[relocate], which is exactly what SearchFree does.

NOTE ON exact_address_required=false: the host never sees a bare hint either. SearchFree only ever returns an address inside a region shadPS4 already reserved at startup, and AddressSpace::Impl::Map then places it with MAP_FIXED (address_space.cpp:751). This requirement is therefore subordinate to the reservation contracts: DEFAULT_MAPPING_BASE 0x200000000 lies inside the system-managed area [0x400000, 0x7FFFFC000), so if shadps4-system-managed-area.json is satisfiable this one is too.

failure_sink.description: unlike the reservation paths, this one degrades gracefully. When SearchFree() cannot place the mapping it returns -1 (memory.cpp:1443, after LOG_ERROR at 1441-1442) and MapMemory returns ORBIS_KERNEL_ERROR_ENOMEM to the guest at memory.cpp:567; MapFile does the same at memory.cpp:744. No assert, no throw. This is the one shadPS4 placement path that models a third outcome.

source_locations.symbol: MemoryManager::MapMemory - virtual_addr = virtual_addr == 0 ? DEFAULT_MAPPING_BASE : virtual_addr (only when MemoryMapFlags::Fixed is NOT set)
MemoryManager::MapMemory - virtual_addr = SearchFree(virtual_addr, size, alignment); the base is a starting hint that SearchFree walks past when occupied
MemoryManager::MapFile - same DEFAULT_MAPPING_BASE fallback, alignment hard-coded to 16_KB at line 741
MemoryManager::SearchFree - bounded by SystemManagedVirtualBase() and UserVirtualBase() + UserVirtualSize()
guard: `} else if (False(flags & MemoryMapFlags::Fixed)) {` - this path is taken only when the guest did not demand fixed placement (MapFile's equivalent guard is at line 739)
